description: This file defines the LicenseAPI class, which is a RESTful API endpoint for managing licenses within the OrangeHRM system. It implements CRUD operations for License objects, providing methods to get, list, create, update, and delete licenses, along with validation rules and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LicenseAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing license entities, supporting CRUD operations with validation and documentation.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LicenseService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single license by ID, returning a LicenseModel encapsulated in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne method, primarily requiring a positive integer ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of licenses with optional sorting and pagination, returning an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing licenses, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new license record based on input parameters.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves license data, either creating or updating, with the provided License object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new license, mainly validating the 'name' field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing license by ID using supplied data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a license, including handling of unique 'name' constraints.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper method to generate validation rules for the license's name, enforcing length and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes licenses specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are provided.
